task.description: Design implementation approach for XC-* cross-cutting requirements: (1) XC-01 trace propagation through all subsystems, (2) XC-02 audit immutability with cryptographic chaining, (3) XC-03 configuration in repository with activation flow, (4) XC-04 kernel determinism (no LLM calls in core paths), (5) XC-05 deterministic replay for non-LLM tiers, (6) XC-06 backwards compatibility for instance/definition migrations. Output design doc to src/design/xc-requirements.md covering: requirements traceability, schema changes needed, module interactions, error handling, and acceptance test strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 6 XC requirements with clear scoping
For each requirement: acceptance criteria identified, affected modules listed, error cases documented
Schema changes (if any) listed with migration implications
No implementation code present; design is specification only

result.summary: Comprehensive design document created for all 6 XC cross-cutting requirements. Design specifies module interactions, schema changes, error handling strategies, and backwards compatibility approach. All acceptance criteria satisfied: full coverage of XC-01 through XC-06, affected modules identified, migration implications documented, specification-only (no code), and backwards compatibility strategy detailed.
